transfer.aboutText: Reliable transfers to and from Tashkent International Airport and any city in Uzbekistan. Meet & greet service, flight tracking, comfortable vehicles. Prices are agreed directly — just tell us your route.

driver.aboutText: A professional personal driver for individuals and families — half-day, full-day or multi-day. English/Russian speaking, comfortable car, flexible itinerary. We agree on everything directly, no fixed pricing.

packages.name: Multi Day

business.aboutText: Professional support for foreign companies and delegations visiting Uzbekistan: interpretation, logistics, venue booking and a personal assistant. Tell us your agenda and we handle the rest.

currency.aboutText: Request help exchanging between any available currencies through an authorized bank or exchange office. Rates change daily, so no fixed rate or price is published.
currency.requestText: Choose the currency you have, the currency you need and an optional amount. Select Other Currency if it is not listed.
currency.customCurrencyPlaceholder: For example: SGD or Singapore dollar
currency.noteText: Travel Easy does not set exchange rates or act as a bank. We help you find an authorized provider, whose current rate and requirements must be confirmed before exchange.
